doc.title: Amazon Web Services Billing Statement Available
doc.content:
Amazon Web Services Billing Statement Available — Amazon Web Services <invoicing@aws.com>, 2026-09-02

Greetings from Amazon Web Services,

This e-mail confirms that your latest billing statement is available on the AWS web site. Your account will be charged the following:

Total in USD: $84.00

The credit card on file is currently your default payment method for your AWS charges.

Thank you for using Amazon Web Services.

Sincerely,
Amazon Web Services
